hypotheses.persona: Elderly resident with mobility and sensory impairments living independently
hypotheses.rationale: Day 9 confirms the pill_organizer is used daily (not just Monday), reinforcing chronic medication management. The consistent morning routine (07:08 meds, 08:22 breakfast cleanup) and evening health monitoring (17:12 BP cuff) remain highly specific to this profile. No evidence contradicts this hypothesis.

hypotheses.persona: Caregiver living with an elderly person
hypotheses.rationale: Discarded. The daily, solitary nature of the routine (meds, coffee, TV, BP check) without any secondary artifacts or distinct caregiver behaviors makes this highly unlikely.

hypotheses.persona: Standard working adult with temporary medical needs
hypotheses.rationale: Discarded. Permanent assistive devices (walker, hearing aids) and daily chronic management are inconsistent with temporary injuries.
